dogecoin.text: I really like seeing that 11 cents seems to be the new #Dogecoin floor. I’m hoping that stays (or increases, obviously). #Doge

Imagine if we told ourselves a week ago that #Doge is gonna take a massive hit all the way down to... $0.26?

We would’ve been confused as hell lol Always remember to zoom out. We’re still doing great. #Dogecoin $Doge

Elon was right when he said Fate Loves Irony.

The majority of the crypto market is tanking right now, but at the same time, everyone’s portfolio is being saved by #Dogecoin. If that’s not irony, I don’t know what is. #Doge #DogeDay #DogeDay420 #DogecoinToTheMoon
@dogecoin_empire It’s on BitMart right now... Took 2 minutes to buy. I just did a small amount to see what it does, but it does feel sketchy.

A simple Google/Twitter search would show you that developers are still actively working to improve #Dogecoin (@dogecoin_devs). We’re having a ton of fun, and we’d love for you to open your mind a little bit and enjoy the ride with us. #Doge

We need more Lex’s in this world. His ability to take in all information, analyze, adjust, but still also have fun is amazing. Thank you for being you, @lexfridman. $DOGE #Dogecoin #DogecoinArmy
